narration.text: He gets accused of living on features. He's done a hundred and eighty-one of them. Future has done two hundred thirty-two. Young Thug, three hundred and two. Fewer verses than either, more streams than anyone: forty-three billion, roughly two hundred forty million a verse.
narration.measuredTranscript: He gets accused of living on features. He's done 181 of them. Future has done 232. Young thug. 302. Fewer verses than either. More streams than anyone. 43 billion. Roughly 240 million a verse.

acceptableDurationSeconds.note: Descriptive. Corpus median 9.0s, p75 14.0s. Never a cap: the evidence sets the length.

internalChangeBudget.note: Advisory. May suggest splitting a unit, but never rejects a candidate and never forces a split. Overridden whenever the content needs the time.

contract.takeaway: He has fewer feature verses than his peers and far more streams from them.

claims.text: Future has done 232 and Young Thug 302.
His features total 43 billion streams, about 240 million a verse.

requiredMedia.contentRequirement: Verified feature counts and stream totals for all three, with the per-verse rate.
Approved portraits for the three named artists, at a size that keeps them identifiable.

visualEvents.triggerPhrase: He's done a hundred and eighty-one of them
Future has done two hundred thirty-two
Young Thug, three hundred and two

visualEvents.description: The stream total reverses the direction of the comparison.

prohibitions.prohibition: Do not imply a high feature count is itself a criticism.
prohibitions.reason: The passage uses the counts to overturn the accusation, not to support it.

successConditions: The viewer sees fewer verses and more streams at once.
failureConditions: The reversal is not visible because counts and streams are shown separately.
